en.title: Electrician vs. Electrical Engineer: Pay, Training, and How to Choose
en.description: Compare electricians and electrical engineers by day-to-day work, training, licensing, and pay.
en.beforeFaq:
## The short answer

**Electricians install, test, and repair electrical systems. Electrical engineers design them and specify how to test them.** In the U.S., May 2025 median annual wages were **$63,190 for electricians** and **$120,630 for electrical engineers**. A common trade route is a four- or five-year apprenticeship with paid on-the-job training. A related engineering bachelor’s degree is the typical route into electrical engineering. [BLS electricians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm) · [BLS electrical engineers](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/electrical-and-electronics-engineers.htm)

## Electrician vs. electrical engineer at a glance

| U.S. comparison | Electrician | Electrical engineer |
|---|---|---|
| Detailed occupation | SOC 47-2111 | SOC 17-2071 |
| Typical deliverable | Installed or restored equipment, test records | Design package, specifications, verification plan |
| O*NET interest code | RC | RIC |
| O*NET Job Zone | 3, medium preparation | 4, considerable preparation |
| Typical entry route | High school diploma or equivalent, then apprenticeship | Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field |
| May 2025 annual wage, 10th percentile | $42,640 | $76,550 |
| May 2025 annual wage, median | $63,190 | $120,630 |
| May 2025 annual wage, 90th percentile | $108,510 | $184,300 |
| Projected employment change, 2025–35 | +9.2% | +9.9% |
| Projected average annual openings, 2025–35 | 72,700 | 11,400 |

The wage figures are May 2025 national BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) estimates. The 10th, 50th, and 90th percentiles are thresholds below which roughly 10%, 50%, and 90% of workers fall. The engineering column uses SOC 17-2071, electrical engineers. The openings figures are annual averages over the projection period and include growth and replacements for people who change occupations or leave the labor force. [BLS percentile definitions](https://www.bls.gov/oes/oes_perc.htm) · [Electrician pay](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm#tab-5) · [Electrical engineer pay](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/electrical-and-electronics-engineers.htm#tab-5) · [BLS detailed projections](https://www.bls.gov/emp/tables/occupational-projections-and-characteristics.htm)

> **The two wage distributions overlap.** The electrician 90th percentile ($108,510) is **$31,960** above the electrical engineer 10th percentile ($76,550). Those figures locate workers within each wage distribution. To compare starting pay, use local apprenticeship schedules and entry-level engineering offers.

## What would each person hand over on the same project?

A U.S. facility is adding equipment to an existing distribution system. The handoff is easiest to see in two documents: the **single-line diagram**, which shows how the new equipment fits into the system, and the **field test record**, which shows what was installed and checked.

The **electrical engineer** may update the single-line diagram and panel schedule, calculate the added loads, and specify what the installation must meet. The project may also call for a short-circuit or arc-flash study. The design team checks the National Electrical Code (NEC) edition and local amendments adopted for the site. The U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs design manual illustrates how these documents fit together on its projects. [VA electrical design manual, §§ 1.9–1.10](https://cfm.va.gov/cfm/til/dManual/dmElec-2025-03.pdf) · [NFPA 70](https://www.nfpa.org/en/Codes-and-Standards/Document-information-pages/70) · [NFPA jurisdictional amendments](https://www.nfpa.org/for-professionals/codes-and-standards/standards-development/nfpa-codes-and-standards-with-jurisdictional-changes)

The **electrician** follows the approved drawing, routes conduit, pulls and terminates conductors, and completes the assigned panel wiring. If the planned route conflicts with equipment already on site, the electrician marks the discrepancy for review. The team assigned to acceptance testing documents results, such as insulation resistance when the test plan calls for it. The engineer reviews any proposed revision against the design requirements. Ask who owns testing and sign-off on that specific project. [O*NET electrician tasks](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00#Tasks) · [O*NET electrical engineer tasks](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-2071.00#Tasks) · [U.S. Department of Energy, federal facilities commissioning](https://www.energy.gov/sites/prod/files/2013/10/f3/commissioning_fed_facilities.pdf)

### Which specialty is the job actually hiring for?

- **Electrician:** An *inside wireman* may work on building wiring and distribution. An industrial maintenance electrician may spend more time finding faults in plant equipment and controls. Utility linework on overhead or underground power lines is a separate U.S. occupation (SOC 49-9051), with its own training and labor statistics. [O*NET Electricians](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00) · [BLS power-line installers and repairers](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/installation-maintenance-and-repair/line-installers-and-repairers.htm)
- **Electrical engineering:** In building-services design (MEP, or mechanical, electrical, and plumbing), look for distribution layouts, lighting, and panel schedules. In an industrial controls posting, look for system requirements, control logic, and testing. Electronics or embedded hardware positions may focus on circuit boards and product prototypes and may fall under a different occupational category. Check the deliverable and the occupation before applying this page’s wage figures. [VA electrical design manual](https://cfm.va.gov/cfm/til/dManual/dmElec-2025-03.pdf) · [BLS electrical and electronics engineering duties](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/electrical-and-electronics-engineers.htm#tab-2) · [BLS computer hardware engineering duties](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/computer-hardware-engineers.htm#tab-2)

## How long does it take, and when does a license matter?

**Electrician.** BLS describes a four- or five-year apprenticeship as a common route. Compare programs by starting pay, scheduled raises, class hours, fees, and whether the sponsor can provide qualifying work consistently. Texas illustrates how exam eligibility may precede license eligibility. On its standard journeyman route, 7,000 qualifying supervised hours can allow an applicant to take the exam, and 8,000 are required for licensure. Check the rule for the jurisdiction and work you want. Philadelphia, for example, issues a city electrical contractor license. A contractor credential and an individual journeyman credential answer different questions about who can do or contract for the work. [BLS apprenticeship guidance](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm) · [Texas licensing](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/electricians/apply/individuals/journeyman-electrician.htm) · [Philadelphia contractor licensing](https://www.phila.gov/services/permits-violations-licenses/get-a-license/trade-licenses/get-an-electrical-contractor-license/)

**Electrical engineer.** A bachelor's degree is the typical entry route. If professional licensure matters for your target roles, check the accreditation of the specific program and the requirements of the state board. A common Professional Engineer route includes an EAC/ABET-accredited engineering degree, the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam, typically four years of acceptable experience, and the Principles and Practice of Engineering (PE) exam. Timing and acceptable experience vary by board. BLS describes licensure as unnecessary for entry-level electrical engineering positions. It matters for responsibilities such as signing off on projects or offering engineering services directly to the public, subject to state rules. [BLS engineering entry and licensure](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/electrical-and-electronics-engineers.htm) · [NCEES licensure guidance](https://ncees.org/Licensure)

Build a five-year cash-flow comparison using real offers. Estimate apprentice wages by year and subtract trade expenses. For college, subtract net tuition and fees, add any reliable co-op income and model a range for the first engineering job. Also compare the next promotion you would want. A trade route can lead toward supervision, master licensure or contracting where applicable. Engineering can lead toward technical specialization, design leadership or project management.

## Which is more physical, and what could AI change?

> **U.S. O*NET 31.0 Work Context: weighted share of workers choosing “continually or almost continually”**
>
| Item, reported as “continually or almost continually” | Electricians | Electrical engineers |
|---|---:|---:|
| Using hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls | **96%** | **26%** |
| Standing | **66%** | **14%** |

For a job you are considering, ask about site time, travel, outage work, and shifts. An engineering role in commissioning can involve substantial field time. [Electrician work context](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00#WorkContext) · [Electrical engineer work context](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-2071.00#WorkContext)

Software could help organize fault histories, draft simulation scripts or turn test logs into a first-pass summary. Those tasks still need verification against a drawing, instrument reading, model assumption or approved revision. The practical question is which parts of the work become faster and who checks the result when the software and the equipment disagree.

## Can an electrician become an electrical engineer?

Yes. Start by deciding whether you want to move into **controls and testing** or take on **design responsibility**. Your experience reading drawings, troubleshooting equipment, and documenting field changes is relevant to both.

**For a move into controls or commissioning**, search for *controls technician*, *electrical commissioning technician*, or *electrical engineering technician*. Read the duties before applying. A controls role may involve supporting programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and drives. A commissioning role may involve running functional checks, logging deficiencies, and preparing test reports. Keep an example of a fault you helped isolate or a test record you improved, with confidential details removed. [O*NET industrial controls technician roles](https://www.onetonline.org/link/custom/49-2094.00) · [O*NET engineering technician duties](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-3023.00)

**If you need coursework**, compare a two-year associate program in **Electrical Engineering Technology (EET)** with a four-year **Bachelor of Science in Engineering Technology (BSET)** with an electrical focus. BLS lists an associate degree as typical preparation for electrical and electronic engineering technologists and technicians. A specific job may ask for more. Compare each program’s controls and lab courses, credit transfer rules, and the kinds of jobs its graduates pursue. Use ABET’s directory to check whether the specific program has Engineering Technology Accreditation Commission (ETAC) accreditation, then confirm its length and course sequence with the school. [BLS engineering technologist and technician preparation](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/electrical-and-electronics-engineering-technicians.htm) · [ABET program search](https://amspub.abet.org/aps/) · [ABET accreditation policy, I.A.](https://www.abet.org/accreditation/accreditation-criteria/accreditation-policy-and-procedure-manual-appm-2026-2027/)

**For a design role or future PE license**, check three things before enrolling: the degree named in target job postings, the accreditation of the specific program, and the state board’s education and experience rules. Texas, for example, evaluates an eligible engineering technology degree under a different education category from an EAC/ABET engineering degree. A good first design portfolio piece is a short calculation or design choice with its assumptions, a test criterion, and a revision you can explain. [NCEES licensure guidance](https://ncees.org/Licensure) · [Texas PE education and experience requirements](https://pels.texas.gov/lic_basic.htm)

## Which path should you try first?

Try the **electrician route** if you want to work with equipment, like finding discrepancies between drawings and the field, and can accept the physical and scheduling demands of the employer you are considering.

Try **electrical engineering** if you enjoy analyzing why a system behaves as it does, explaining why a design meets its constraints, and defending a revision with evidence.

Both occupational profiles lead with R, the Realistic interest dimension. C is Conventional, and I is Investigative. The codes describe activities associated with the occupation and can guide a trial task. A hiring decision depends on demonstrated skills and qualifications. To explore the difference, take the same training drawing and make two paper deliverables. For the field role, prepare a drawing-to-equipment checklist and flag an inconsistency. For engineering, draft a requirements-to-tests matrix and explain what evidence would trigger a design change. Ask for feedback and notice which deliverable you want to improve.

## Frequently asked questions

faq.question: Does an electrical engineer earn almost twice as much as an electrician?
faq.answer: The May 2025 U.S. electrical engineer median was about 1.9 times the electrician median. For a personal decision, compare local offers at similar career stages and account for paid apprenticeship time or college expenses. [BLS electrician wages](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm) · [BLS electrical engineer wages](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/architecture-and-engineering/electrical-and-electronics-engineers.htm)

faq.question: Can an electrical engineer work as an electrician?
faq.answer: Engineering training helps with theory and design review. For regulated installation work, check whether the state or locality requires an electrician credential and qualifying supervised hours. [Texas journeyman licensing](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/electricians/apply/individuals/journeyman-electrician.htm)

faq.question: Is commissioning a good place to compare both paths?
faq.answer: It can be. Read several descriptions for the same type of equipment. Compare who gathers measurements, who interprets the results against the specification and who can approve a change. Those responsibilities tell you more than the word *commissioning* in the job title.

faq.question: Do all U.S. states require a state electrician license?
faq.answer: No. BLS reports that most states require electrician licensure. Check both state and local rules for where you will work. Texas issues individual electrician licenses, while New York City issues city licenses for master and special electricians. The credential to perform work as an employee, the one to supervise work, and the one to contract with customers can have different rules. [BLS electrician licensing](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm#tab-4) · [Texas individual licensing](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/electricians/apply/individuals/journeyman-electrician.htm) · [New York City electrician licensing](https://www.nyc.gov/site/buildings/industry/master-electricians-special-electricians.page)

faq.question: Master Electrician vs. Professional Engineer (PE): what is the difference?
faq.answer: A master electrician license is a trade credential tied to performing or supervising electrical work under the local rules. In Texas, an electrical contractor must assign their own Master Electrician license to the business or employ a licensed Master Electrician and register that person as the Master Electrician of Record. A PE license is issued by an engineering board and can authorize professional engineering work such as sealing engineering plans within the state’s rules. Check which person can supervise installation, pull permits, or sign the design for your project. [Texas master electrician license](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/electricians/apply/individuals/master-electrician.htm) · [Texas electrical contractor rules](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/electricians/elecfaq.htm) · [Texas Engineering Practice Act](https://tcss.legis.texas.gov/resources/OC/htm/OC.1001.htm)

methods.label: Data definitions and methods
methods.body:
The Work Context figures use O*NET 31.0’s category percentages (CXP) for the highest frequency response. For each occupation and item, divide the summed survey weight for the selected response by the total weight of valid responses. The unit is weighted responses. The individual item samples range from 18 to 19 workers. The estimates are imprecise, and the confidence intervals for standing overlap substantially.

| Item | Electricians 47-2111.00 | Electrical engineers 17-2071.00 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Using hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls | 96.42%, n=18 | 26.33%, n=19 |
| Standing | 66.31%, n=18 | 14.13%, n=18 |

The source records are dated August 2022 for electricians and August 2023 for electrical engineers. The comparison above rounds the values to whole percentages. Use them to decide which working conditions to ask an employer about. [O*NET 31.0 data dictionary](https://www.onetcenter.org/dictionary/31.0/csv/work_context.html) · [O*NET weighting method, equation 30](https://www.onetcenter.org/dl_files/omb2024/Supporting_StatementB.pdf)

zh.title: 电工和电气工程师有什么区别？从入行到转岗，一次看清
zh.description: 比较电工和电气工程师的日常工作、入行路径、证书与职业发展。
zh.beforeFaq:
## 先看你想对哪种结果负责

**电工主要在现场安装、检查和修复线路或设备。电气工程师主要做计算、设计，并确定方案怎么验证。** 在中国大陆，想走现场路线，可以从职业院校实训入手，按目标作业核对是否要取证。想走设计路线，可以看电气工程及其自动化（本科专业代码 080601）等专业。 [教育部本科专业目录](https://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A08/moe_1034/s3882/202604/t20260427_1434931.html) · [应急管理部第 19 号令](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/gz11/202512/t20251219_589223.shtml)

## 电工和电气工程师对比表

| 对比 | 电工 | 电气工程师 |
|---|---|---|
| 核心交付 | 合格的安装或维修、测量与交接记录 | 图纸、计算或选型说明、测试方案 |
| 美国 O*NET 兴趣短码 | RC，现实型、常规型 | RIC，现实型、研究型、常规型 |
| 美国 O*NET 准备度 | Job Zone 3，中等准备 | Job Zone 4，较多准备 |
| 中国大陆学习入口 | 职业教育可看电气自动化技术，按目标岗位选实训 | 本科可看电气工程及其自动化（080601） |
| 中国大陆核对门槛 | 亲自做目录内作业，先核具体项目和对应操作证 | 先核岗位学历与交付要求。担任规定项目的设计专业负责人，再核注册执业和签章要求 |
| 一天里常用的工具 | 图纸、万用表、钳形表、手动和电动工具 | CAD、电路或系统仿真工具、试验数据 |

两岗都以现实型 R 为首。区分它们，可以看你是否喜欢在任务中反复建立假设、比较方案并解释试验结果。Job Zone 是美国职业准备度分类。中国的教育和证书要求按下文对应制度理解。 [O*NET 电工](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00) · [O*NET 电气工程师](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-2071.00) · [教育部本科专业目录](https://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A08/moe_1034/s3882/202604/t20260427_1434931.html)

## 同一个配电改造项目，两岗怎么交接？

**设计阶段。** 工程师确认新增设备的负荷、空间和停机限制，比较方案，把选型理由、图纸和验收条件交给施工与调试团队。图纸变更时，审查人需要看得出改了哪项假设。

**施工阶段。** 电工核对现场标签和图纸，按批准的方案安装并记录差异。遇到柜体空间与图纸不符，电工提交现场信息，工程师评估替代方案，双方用批准后的图纸继续交接。

**验收阶段。** 电工交出按工作范围完成的测量和缺陷记录。工程师用记录判断设计要求是否满足，并追踪未关闭的问题。同样一条读数，现场要交代它怎么取得，设计侧要解释它能验证哪项要求。 [O*NET 电工任务](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00) · [O*NET 电气工程师任务](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-2071.00)

## 在中国大陆，怎么入行？入行后能往哪走？

**电工路线。** 先看岗位是建筑施工、工厂设备维护还是变配电运行。工作里要亲自做目录内的电工作业，就先核对是低压、高压还是其他操作项目，再查适用的发证体系。房屋市政施工中的建筑电工作业，按住建系统的规定核对操作资格。省级住建主管部门负责资格认定，可依法委托设区的市级住建主管部门实施考核相关工作。持有效应急管理高压或低压电工作业证，申请建筑电工证时可免培训、直接参加考核；持有效建筑电工证，申请应急管理低压电工作业证时也可免培训、直接参加考试。两条路径都要通过相应考核后取证。另按目录说明，持有效高压电工作业证可从事低压电工作业。职业教育可关注电气自动化技术的安装、调试和维护实训。算入行时间时，把培训考核、带教和能独立承担目标作业的时间分开。 [应急管理部第 19 号令，第 3、4、9 条](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/gz11/202512/t20251219_589223.shtml) · [2026 年特种作业目录](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/202605/W020260526532904903760.pdf) · [住建部第 60 号令，第 3、5 条](https://www.mohurd.gov.cn/gongkai/zhengce/gzk/art/2025/art_f3913c15c84e4bbc8d4fb21af3370fb8.html) · [四部门证书互通互认通知](https://policy.mofcom.gov.cn/claw/clawContent.shtml?id=104536) · [电气自动化技术培养方案示例](https://qsy.jinan.gov.cn/colqsy8827/art/2024/art_qsy8827_qsy62162.html)

**工程师路线。** 选专业时可看电气工程及其自动化，比较电路、电机、电力系统或控制方向的课程与实验。毕业前争取做一个能讲清设计约束、验证过程和改版理由的项目。入职后可探索供配电、设备研发、测试验证或项目技术负责等方向。做预算时，把学费和就学期间少赚的收入，与同城同资历岗位的固定工资、加班和出差补贴分开算。 [教育部本科专业目录](https://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A08/moe_1034/s3882/202604/t20260427_1434931.html)

### 招聘写「电气」，先问做的是哪条线

- **建筑电气与工厂供配电（常说的「强电」方向）**。看图纸、设备选型和配电验收相关的职责，也看现场岗位是否负责线路安装、配电设备运行或检修。同一个供配电项目里，这两种岗位交付的东西不同。
- **工业自动化**。招聘写 PLC、控制柜或变频器时，问清是负责订控制逻辑、做方案和验证，还是主要接线、调试和排故。供配电与控制往往出现在同一台设备上，优先按任务分辨岗位。
- **弱电和电子硬件**。建筑项目里的「弱电」常指通信、综合布线、安防等系统。电子硬件岗则可能围绕电路板和产品试验开展。看到「电气工程师」这个标题，直接问最后交的是配电图、控制程序，还是硬件原理图。 [电气自动化技术培养方案示例](https://qsy.jinan.gov.cn/colqsy8827/art/2024/art_qsy8827_qsy62162.html) · [教育部本科专业目录](https://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A08/moe_1034/s3882/202604/t20260427_1434931.html) · [温州项目建筑弱电设计说明，工程范围](https://zjjcmspublic.oss-cn-hangzhou-zwynet-d01-a.internet.cloud.zj.gov.cn/jcms_files/jcms1/web1940/site/attach/0/40144d87ddf345069671034c35906b85.pdf)

### 电工的操作证和技能等级证，各管什么？

**特种作业操作证**对应证载作业项目的上岗要求。**职业技能等级证书**记录通过评价的技能等级，可用于企业的技能岗位聘用和晋升评价。电工国家职业技能标准列五级，从五级／初级工到一级／高级技师。「新八级工」在五级基础上向下补设学徒工，符合条件的工种可向上设特级技师、首席技师岗位，按评聘办理。持有合法有效、与申请作业相应的职业技能等级证书，可以按第 9 条免相应安全技术培训，考核和取得操作证仍须按规定办理。 [电工国家职业技能标准](https://chinajob.mohrss.gov.cn/h5/c/2019-01-03/232794.shtml) · [人社部「新八级工」政策问答](https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/SYrlzyhshbzb/ztzl/rsxthfjszl/zcjd/202304/t20230420_498766.html) · [应急管理部第 19 号令](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/gz11/202512/t20251219_589223.shtml)

### 「工程师」是岗位、职称，还是注册资格？

招聘里的「电气工程师」是岗位名称。**工程系列职称**评价专业技术水平，设技术员、助理工程师、工程师、高级工程师、正高级工程师。**注册电气工程师**对应规定范围内的专业执业。住建部建市规〔2026〕1 号规定，从 2026 年 6 月 1 日起，工程设计资质标准规定的有关中型及以上建设项目，相应电气设计专业负责人须由注册电气工程师担任，并在规定的设计文件上签字盖章。看制造、自动化或售后岗位时，问清招聘条件、职称申报条件和项目签章职责分别是什么。 [人社部、工信部工程系列职称指导意见](https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/zyjsrygls/ZYJSRYGLSzhengcewenjian/201902/t20190222_310736.html) · [住建部注册执业通知](https://www.mohurd.gov.cn/gongkai/zc/xzgfxwjk/art/2026/art_2063777831.html)

## 哪个更累？AI 会改变哪些任务？

> **美国 O*NET 31.0 工作环境｜在职者选择「持续或几乎持续」的加权比例**
>
| 题项 | 电工 | 电气工程师 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 用手操作、控制或感知物体、工具或控制装置 | **96%** | **26%** |
| 站立 | **66%** | **14%** |

看国内岗位时，直接问现场工时、倒班、停机检修窗口和出差频率。调试岗也可能长期驻场。 [O*NET 电工工作环境](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00#WorkContext) · [电气工程师工作环境](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-2071.00#WorkContext)

按任务看，软件可以辅助整理巡检记录、生成仿真脚本初稿或比较测试结果。现场设备身份、异常复查、模型假设和最终验收仍要由项目人员确认。面试时问清谁能决定停工、谁复核测量、谁批准设计变更，比问一个笼统的替代概率更有用。

## 电工转电气工程师难在哪？

识图、设备识别、故障定位和测试记录能迁移到调试、测试或工程支持。转设计岗还要补电路分析、设计计算、规范应用和验证计划。先读三个目标岗位的学历与交付要求，再拿一张匿名或教学用单线图，做一页选型说明、一张验收矩阵和一次修改记录。若三岗都要独立完成计算与审查，就把补课和工程项目经历计入转岗时间。 [O*NET 电工技能](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2111.00) · [O*NET 电气工程师技能](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/17-2071.00)

## 我更适合选电工还是电气工程师？

- **优先试电工。** 你喜欢实物操作，愿意反复核对图纸和测量结果，也接受目标岗位的现场环境与班次。
- **优先试电气工程师。** 你喜欢计算与选型，愿意写下设计取舍，也愿意按测试反馈重做方案。
- **两条都想试。** 用同一张教学图纸做两份纸面作业。先做现场核对清单，再做需求到验收的对照表。看哪份作业在收到反例后，你更愿意继续改。

## 常见问题

faq.question: 有低压电工证，能做电气工程设计吗？
faq.answer: 低压电工证对应低压电工作业。应聘设计岗，先看招聘要求你能独立做哪些计算、图纸和验证。若工作还包括规定项目的设计签章，要另外满足注册执业要求。 [2026 年特种作业目录](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/202605/W020260526532904903760.pdf) · [住建部注册执业通知](https://www.mohurd.gov.cn/gongkai/zc/xzgfxwjk/art/2026/art_2063777831.html)

faq.question: 本科读电气，毕业就能从事目录内电工作业吗？
faq.answer: 先确认目标作业。按第 19 号令，中职（含技工学校）及以上学历的毕业生，申请与所学专业相应的操作证，提交学历证明并经考核发证机关同意后，可以免相应安全技术培训。上岗前仍要按规定考核取证。 [应急管理部第 19 号令，第 4、9 条](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/gz11/202512/t20251219_589223.shtml)

faq.question: 电气工程师在企业里需要考低压电工证吗？
faq.answer: 看你会不会亲自做目录内的低压电工作业。担任调试、售后或维护岗位时，问清你是负责分析和指导，还是需要亲手安装、检修或调试低压电气设备。涉及目录内作业的，按实际项目和场景核对持证要求。 [应急管理部第 19 号令](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/gz11/202512/t20251219_589223.shtml) · [2026 年特种作业目录](https://www.mem.gov.cn/gk/zfxxgkpt/fdzdgknr/202605/W020260526532904903760.pdf)

faq.question: 电工和电气工程师，哪个发展上限更高？
faq.answer: 看你想往哪条路走。电工可以深耕设备维护、成为技师，或转向班组管理。电气工程师可以深耕系统设计与验证，或转向项目技术负责人、工程管理。比收入时，挑同城、同资历的目标岗位，看能负责多大的项目、工资怎么构成、晋升看哪些成果。 [人社部技能等级政策问答](https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/SYrlzyhshbzb/ztzl/rsxthfjszl/zcjd/202304/t20230420_498766.html) · [工程系列职称指导意见](https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/zyjsrygls/ZYJSRYGLSzhengcewenjian/201902/t20190222_310736.html)

faq.question: RC 和 RIC 都喜欢实物，怎么用结果选方向？
faq.answer: 把 R 当成两个方向都值得试的线索。比较你更愿意反复做现场复核，还是为设计提出假设、检验证据并修订方案。

en.title: Audiologist vs. Physical Therapist: Which Kind of Patient Work Fits You?
en.description: Compare audiology and physical therapy by what clinicians measure and hand off, along with U.S. doctoral training, state licensing and national median pay.
en.beforeFaq:
## Start with the result you would follow

Audiologists assess hearing and related balance problems, explain test findings, and may fit hearing devices. Physical therapists assess movement and build treatment plans around how patients move and function. Both fields can involve balance care. Audiology is a field to explore if you want much of your day to involve measurement and interpretation. Look into physical therapy if coaching movement and tracking changes across visits sounds more rewarding. [BLS audiologists](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/audiologists.htm) · [BLS physical therapists](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/physical-therapists.htm)

## Compare the U.S. entry paths and pay

| U.S. comparison | Audiologist | Physical therapist |
|---|---|---|
| Core output | Hearing or balance findings, counseling, and a follow-up plan as appropriate | Functional assessment, treatment plan, and progress notes |
| Typical entry credential | Doctor of Audiology (Au.D.) | Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) |
| Licensing | Required in all states | Required in all states |
| May 2025 median annual wage | $95,780 | $102,760 |
| O*NET interest code | IS | SIR |

The pay figures are national BLS occupational medians for SOC 29-1181 and 29-1123. Compare tuition, placement costs, and local pay when deciding between programs. [BLS audiology pay](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/audiologists.htm#tab-5) · [BLS physical therapy pay](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/physical-therapists.htm#tab-5) · [O*NET audiologists](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1181.00) · [O*NET physical therapists](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1123.00)

## One outpatient center, two different notes

Imagine a patient who has trouble following conversation over background noise and feels less steady when turning. Consider two appointments already arranged by the care team. The audiologist's note might explain what hearing tests measured, where communication remains difficult, and what follow-up would help the clinician compare results. The physical therapist's note might describe how the patient manages a turn or a walk, which activity the patient wants to regain confidence doing, and what measure the clinician could repeat. Each note gives the next clinician a different place to start.

## Compare supervised training before you apply

For audiology, ask how programs expose students to diagnostic testing, counseling, hearing-device care, and balance services. For physical therapy, ask which settings and patient populations clinical placements cover and how students learn to document progress. Check licensure requirements with the board where you plan to work. Ask the school how its placements and program accreditation support that state's path. [BLS audiology preparation and licensing](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/audiologists.htm#tab-4) · [BLS physical therapy preparation and licensing](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/physical-therapists.htm#tab-4)

## Visit the setting you would actually work in

An audiology clinic can tell you how the day is split between testing, device appointments, documentation, and counseling. A physical therapy practice can tell you how often therapists are on their feet, whether clinicians help patients move, and how many return visits they typically track. Ask both sites what the person does when a measurement and the patient's experience tell different stories. [BLS audiology work environment](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/audiologists.htm#tab-3) · [BLS physical therapy work environment](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/physical-therapists.htm#tab-3)

## Thinking of switching between the fields?

Explaining results, keeping usable records, and coordinating follow-up can transfer as skills. For an actual switch, map your previous courses against the new program's prerequisites and ask which credits it accepts. Then ask the relevant licensing board about the target profession's education and exam requirements. Budget for the new program and clinical placements using its own timeline.

## Try a 30-minute documentation exercise

Use two fictional notes. In one, a person misses words in noisy meetings and reports a change after trying a hearing device. In the other, a person walks down a hallway but hesitates on turns. Take 10 minutes per note to write what you know, what question you would ask next, and which observation you would want to compare at a later appointment. Spend the last 10 minutes deciding which type of documentation you would be happy to revise every day. Use the exercise to compare the work, with no clinical testing involved.

## Frequently asked questions
en.afterFaq: Read the [audiologist profile](/en/career/jobs/audiologists) and [physical therapist profile](/en/career/jobs/physical-therapists). The [Holland career interest test](/en/tests/holland-career-interest-test-riasec) can help you put your task preferences into words.

faq.question: Do both professions work with balance?
faq.answer: They can. Audiology may assess hearing and related balance function. Physical therapy may track how steadiness affects turning, walking, and other activities.

faq.question: Can I go directly from one license to the other?
faq.answer: Check the new profession's own education, examination, and state requirements. The skills that carry over are useful when planning coursework, clinical placements, and a job search.

faq.question: Which profession pays more?
faq.answer: In the May 2025 U.S. BLS data, the physical therapist median is higher. For your own decision, compare entry-level local offers and program costs.

zh.title: 听力学家和物理治疗师有什么区别？从两份门诊记录看分工
zh.description: 听力学家主要评估听觉和相关平衡功能，物理治疗师主要评估动作功能。用两份门诊记录对照任务、入行和国内岗位名称。
zh.beforeFaq:
## 先看你想跟踪什么变化

听力学家常要弄清一个人听见了什么、在哪些场景听不清，再解释测量结果，按岗位范围参与听力设备服务和随访。物理治疗师常要弄清一个人怎么站、怎么走、完成日常活动有什么困难，再跟踪功能变化。两边都可能接触平衡问题。看岗时，可以问哪份记录要由你长期维护，报告交给谁，下一次复查要跟上次比较什么。[O*NET 听力学家任务](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1181.00#Tasks) · [O*NET 物理治疗师任务](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1123.00#Tasks)

## 把两份工作记录放在一起

| 比较项 | 听力学家 | 物理治疗师 |
|---|---|---|
| 常见记录 | 听力与相关检查结果、解释及随访安排 | 动作功能观察、计划和进展记录 |
| 工作现场 | 核对测量条件，组织测试，向来访者或团队解释发现 | 观察动作，指导活动，跟踪目标完成情况 |
| 美国 O*NET 兴趣短码 | IS，研究型、社会型 | SIR，社会型、研究型、现实型 |
| 看国内岗位先问 | 主要负责检测、报告沟通，还是设备验配与随访？ | 主要负责功能评估、治疗实施，还是康复随访？ |

短码来自美国 O*NET 职业资料。两岗都包含分析和面对面沟通，选方向时先看你愿意围绕哪类变化反复工作。[O*NET 听力学家](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1181.00) · [O*NET 物理治疗师](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1123.00)

## 同一家门诊，两边会交出什么？

虚构例子。一位来访者记录了两件事：在嘈杂处听不清对话，外出步行时对转身缺少信心。假设团队分别安排听力和康复评估，听力侧可以交一份检查报告，说明这次测量覆盖了什么、来访者在哪些沟通情境仍有困难。康复侧可以交一份活动记录，说明转身和步行在哪些条件下受到影响，以及下次准备核对的功能变化。实际是否安排这两类服务，由接诊机构按分工决定。

## 在中国大陆找岗，先把服务和岗位分开查

本文用美国职业分类对照两岗的任务。下面的国内资料能确认服务场景，尚不能确定两岗在中国大陆各有一一对应的岗位或独立准入资格。Au.D.、DPT 和州执照属于美国的入行路径。

听力方向可分别用「听力检测」「听力评估」「助听器验配」搜工作。国家卫生健康委的指导意见将筛查后的转诊、诊疗、康复以及助听设备验配纳入服务链。选岗时请机构说清你会做其中哪段、谁核签报告，是否兼做设备服务。[国家卫健委耳与听力健康指导意见](https://wjw.fujian.gov.cn/xxgk/fgwj/gjwj/202508/t20250821_6994173.htm)

物理治疗方向可同时查「康复治疗」「运动功能评估」「物理治疗」。综合医院康复医学科可开展物理治疗等服务，科室的服务范围和某个岗位的授权需要分别了解。投递前把专业、允许承担的项目和需要核验的资格列出来，请目标机构确认专业、相关资格或注册（如适用）、可承担项目及谁核签报告。两条路线都应以国内岗位的职责与授权为准。[卫生部综合医院康复医学科指南](https://www.nhc.gov.cn/cmsresources/mohbgt/cmsrsdocument/doc12214.pdf) · [康复治疗专业人员培训大纲](https://www.nhc.gov.cn/yzygj/c100068/202311/2614b8c4ffa84423b3b1ec7ef7a9aa15.shtml)

## 哪种工作节奏值得提前看一眼？

看听力岗位，问一天中检测、解释报告和设备随访分别怎么排。看康复岗位，问一次就诊要观察哪些动作、是否要长时间站立或辅助活动、每周用什么记录变化。同样重沟通，一边经常把测量结果讲给来访者听，另一边经常要把动作目标讲清并观察执行。

## 想换方向，哪些成果可以带过去？

可以带上合规去标识的服务改进成果，例如让团队更容易读懂的随访模板或一份可重复使用的记录流程。想转听力方向，进一步查课程和带教如何覆盖听觉测量、结果解释及设备服务。想转物理治疗方向，查课程和带教如何覆盖功能评估、动作观察以及计划调整，并了解目标岗位的资格要求。

## 30 分钟纸面试做

虚构两份记录。第一份列出「安静房间能听清、多人对话时常漏词、设备使用后未复查」。第二份列出「能走过走廊、转身时想扶栏、下次希望能用同一条件复测」。各用 10 分钟写一则交接说明，分别说明已知事实、最想追问的一个问题和下一次该记录什么。最后 10 分钟比较自己愿意反复打磨哪一份。全程使用纸面信息。

## 常见问题与下一步
zh.afterFaq: 继续看[听力学家职业档案](/zh/career/jobs/audiologists)和[物理治疗师职业档案](/zh/career/jobs/physical-therapists)。也可用[霍兰德职业兴趣测试](/zh/tests/holland-career-interest-test-riasec)了解自己在测量分析、解释和指导活动上的兴趣。

faq.question: 两边都做平衡相关工作，怎么区分？
faq.answer: 先看记录的对象。听力侧可关注听觉与相关平衡检查，物理治疗侧常跟踪站立、移动和具体活动的功能表现。

faq.question: 看到「听力师」或「物理治疗师」招聘名就能判断要什么证吗？
faq.answer: 仅凭招聘名或美国职业分类无法对应中国大陆的具体证书。把招聘名称对应到实际工作项目，再请用人机构说明所核验的专业、资格和授权。

faq.question: 去哪了解日常最有效？
faq.answer: 请意向科室或服务机构举一个典型工作日。重点问上午做什么、下午交什么、哪些记录需要团队复核。

en.title: Carpet Installer vs. Floor Layer: Materials, Pay, and Training
en.description: Compare carpet installers and floor layers by the work orders they handle, what counts as a finished job, and U.S. pay and training.
en.beforeFaq:
## Read the material list before the job title

Carpet installers plan layouts, fit carpet and padding, join seams, and finish edges. The detailed U.S. floor-layer occupation used here covers work such as fitting sheet vinyl and linoleum around doors and fixtures. If a posting just says “flooring installer,” ask what the crew laid last week and which finished detail you would be expected to hand over. [O*NET carpet installers](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2041.00#Tasks) · [O*NET floor layers](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2042.00#Tasks)

## Compare the two work orders and national wages

| U.S. comparison | Carpet installer | Floor layer in this comparison |
|---|---|---|
| Detailed SOC | 47-2041 | 47-2042, except carpet, wood, and hard tiles |
| Example materials | Carpet and pad | Sheet flooring and underlayment as specified |
| Layout decision | Where to place seams, given traffic and appearance | Where to allow for cutouts and joints, given fixed obstacles |
| May 2025 median annual wage | $50,340 | $56,460 |
| O*NET interest code | RC | RC |

BLS reports those medians separately. Its floor-layer description also includes some laminate and manufactured-wood installations. The category name gives you a statistical boundary. Use the material list to understand an individual opening. [BLS flooring duties and pay](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/tile-and-marble-setters.htm)

## Two units in one apartment turnover

Unit A gets carpet in a living room. The carpet installer marks the likely route from the door to the hall and plans how the seam will sit in relation to that route. The handoff is a finished carpet and edge treatment the supervisor can inspect along the entry and the joins. Unit B gets sheet flooring around a cabinet. The floor layer marks where the material must fit against its outline and how the edge meets the doorway. The handoff is a fitted surface the supervisor can check at the cabinet and the joints. Both crews need accurate measurements. The mistakes that cause rework differ once the cuts and joins are laid out.

## Ask what the crew will teach you

BLS describes on-the-job training and apprenticeship routes in the broader flooring field. Ask whether a new worker starts with preparation and measuring, who demonstrates material-specific techniques, and how the crew decides when someone can handle a seam or a transition on their own. If the job also includes taking contracts, check the applicable state or local contractor rules for that role. [BLS training and credentials](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/tile-and-marble-setters.htm#tab-4)

## Compare the pace, lifting, and time on your knees

Flooring work can involve bending, reaching, or kneeling for extended periods. An occupied renovation may also have short access windows and tight schedules for handing rooms back. Ask whether you will move rolls or cartons, remove existing flooring, and work on one site all week or travel between jobs. Each answer can matter more to your day than the national wage difference. [BLS flooring work environment](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/tile-and-marble-setters.htm#tab-3)

## Switch materials without starting from scratch

Bring examples of measuring, laying out a room, and documenting a finished surface. To switch toward carpet, ask to learn pad fit, seam placement, and doorway finish. To switch toward resilient flooring, ask to learn how the crew marks fixed obstacles and checks joints. During an interview, ask for one example of work the supervisor sends back and what makes it pass the second time.

## Try two room sketches in 30 minutes

Sketch a living room with a doorway and a kitchen with a fixed cabinet. Give yourself 12 minutes to plan a carpet seam around the main traffic route, and 12 minutes to mark cuts and joints for a sheet-flooring layout around the cabinet. In the last six minutes, write the three things each supervisor would need to check before accepting the room. Use paper and an imaginary work order.

## Frequently asked questions
en.afterFaq: See the [carpet installer profile](/en/career/jobs/carpet-installers) and [floor layer profile](/en/career/jobs/floor-layers-except-carpet-wood-and-hard-tiles). Use the [Holland career interest test](/en/tests/holland-career-interest-test-riasec) to describe which hands-on tasks you most want to explore.

faq.question: Are carpet installers and floor layers listed separately?
faq.answer: Yes. The BLS handbook groups the trades for its overview, then reports separate figures for carpet installers (47-2041) and this detailed floor-layer occupation (47-2042).

faq.question: Does the higher national median mean I should switch?
faq.answer: Compare local crew rates and expected paid hours. Ask which preparation and rework are included before treating two offers as equivalent.

faq.question: What should I ask an employer first?
faq.answer: Ask what materials you would work with most weeks, which parts of the job you would learn first, and who judges the finished work.

zh.title: 地毯安装工和地板铺设工有什么区别？看材料、接缝和验收
zh.description: 用同一层办公改造对照地毯拼缝与弹性地材裁边。附国内工单核对清单、转岗要补的工序和纸面试做。
zh.beforeFaq:
## 招聘都写地面施工，先问主要铺什么

地毯安装工常做地毯排版、衬垫、拼缝和门边收口。这里对比的地板铺设工采用美国细分类，指「地板铺设工（非地毯、木地板与硬质瓷砖类）」。以弹性卷材为例，该角色常按图裁切、避让障碍、修整边缘并让材料接合。两岗都处理尺寸和接缝，材料怎么到达完成面才是求职时最值得问的区别。[O*NET 地毯安装工](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2041.00#Tasks) · [O*NET 地板铺设工](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/47-2042.00#Tasks)

## 两份工单的交付重点

| 对照 | 地毯安装工 | 地板铺设工 |
|---|---|---|
| 本例用料 | 满铺地毯，按工单决定是否加衬垫 | 弹性卷材，底层材料按项目配置 |
| 排版时先想 | 主要通行路线、接缝走向、门边怎么收 | 拐角、柱脚或固定柜台造成的异形裁口 |
| 交付时重点看 | 缝位、边缘和过渡是否符合工单 | 裁口合不合轮廓，材料交接是否贴合 |
| 美国 O*NET 兴趣短码 | RC，现实型、常规型 | RC，现实型、常规型 |

两岗短码相同。选方向时，可以拿真实材料或工单细分任务。济南住建部门公开的 GB 50209—2010 第 6.9 节列出地毯拼缝、表面和边缘等检查项。具体工程按自身图纸、合同与适用要求核验。[建筑地面工程施工质量验收规范，第 6.9 节](https://jncc.jinan.gov.cn/api-gateway/jpaas-web-server/front/document/download?fileName=b0b0fb7faa5342c49061445cfae5da53.pdf&fileUrl=n9s7FT%2FT21J6Ntg6aan3xDmP2b3NP5aKuPuvnTGi6yy2qr1fkK5gvTjhu8WZDPZnzEK16fDDNXNvwYFufHIlRzWCjhx6k58nE88hvCG3%2Btn46EmM5560Tzy95VdbS7JJ)

## 同一楼层，两种交接

同一次办公楼改造中，会议室铺地毯，茶水间铺弹性卷材。会议室的工单图先标主通道和门洞。地毯安装工要在排版时考虑哪条缝会落在高频通行线上，交付时让验收人能顺着图找到各条拼缝和需要检查的边缘。茶水间的工单图先标固定柜和柱脚。地板铺设工要把不规则轮廓反映到裁切计划，交付时让验收人按图核对柜脚、门边和相邻面材是否贴合。若公共门洞需要衔接两种材料，施工前先确认谁负责交界过渡，谁核对完成面的标高和连接。

## 在国内入行，用工单拆开问条件

目前能直接对照的是两类工作的材料、工序和交验。仅凭本文资料，无法确认这两个美国职业分类在中国大陆各有一一对应的岗位或独立资格。

用「地毯铺装」「PVC 地材」「弹性卷材铺设」等词查对应项目。请雇主给一份去标识的材料清单，问清谁处理基层、谁做边缘和门口、谁复核完成面。再分别确认入场培训、项目要求和雇主要核的技能或资格。谈报酬时，把计时、计件或面积结算问清，还要问算不算基层处理、收边和返工。施工验收表可帮助理解交付项，岗位所需资格要按目标项目核对。

## 看现场条件，先问占用与工期

住宅或仍在营业的场地，施工窗口可能比空场更紧。问一周有几天在工地、材料如何运到作业面、需要连续跪蹲多久、基层未具备条件时谁决定延期。来回在不同小项目间换场，和在同一大项目重复铺装，节奏差很多。用目标团队最近一周的工单校准自己的预期。[美国 BLS 地面安装工作环境](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/tile-and-marble-setters.htm#tab-3)

## 转材料方向，作品集应该换什么？

已会量尺寸、读图和交接的，可以带一份以前画的排版草图或验收记录。由地毯转弹性地材，补异形轮廓记录、裁口和接缝的样例。由弹性地材转地毯，补通行条件下的排版、拼缝和衬垫记录。向带教老师问清哪段最容易返工、做到什么程度可以独立交付。

## 用 30 分钟做两张纸面工单

画一间带门洞的长方形会议室和一间带固定柜的茶水间。先用 12 分钟在会议室图上标通道、候选拼缝和交付检查点，再用 12 分钟在茶水间图上标异形裁口、材料交界和需要复量的位置。最后 6 分钟写下两组工人交接门洞时谁应复核哪项信息。用草图和纸笔就能完成。

## 常见问题与下一步
zh.afterFaq: 延伸看[地毯安装工职业档案](/zh/career/jobs/carpet-installers)和[地板铺设工职业档案](/zh/career/jobs/floor-layers-except-carpet-wood-and-hard-tiles)，也可以用[霍兰德职业兴趣测试](/zh/tests/holland-career-interest-test-riasec)看看自己对动手操作和按图核对的兴趣。

faq.question: 地板铺设工这个名字包括地毯吗？
faq.answer: 现实中的「地面施工」可能兼铺多种材料。本页对比的美国分类把地毯安装单独统计。国内求职应看材料清单。

faq.question: 两岗的兴趣短码一样，还怎么选？
faq.answer: 对照你更愿意练的成果。地毯可看在动线限制下怎么排缝，卷材可看怎样处理异形裁口和材料交界。

faq.question: 问雇主哪一句最有效？
faq.answer: 问「最近一周主要铺哪种材料，我会做哪道工序，哪项要由我交验？」

en.title: Veterinarian vs. Veterinary Technician: Who Decides and Who Carries It Out?
en.description: Compare veterinarians and veterinary technologists or technicians by clinical responsibility, U.S. education and pay, and a California delegation example.
en.beforeFaq:
## Start with the decision you want to be responsible for

Veterinarians diagnose animals, decide on treatment, and may prescribe medication or perform surgery. Veterinary technologists and technicians gather observations, perform permitted tests, and help deliver and monitor care under supervision. This comparison focuses on clinical practice in animal hospitals and clinics. In an interview, ask which decisions you would own and which findings you would be expected to report to the veterinarian. [BLS veterinarians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinarians.htm) · [BLS veterinary technologists and technicians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.htm)

## Compare U.S. responsibilities, education, and pay

| U.S. comparison | Veterinarian | Veterinary technologist or technician |
|---|---|---|
| Main output | Diagnosis, treatment decision, clinical plan | Test results, observation records, and care handoff |
| Typical entry education | Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree | Associate degree is typical for technicians; bachelor's degree is typical for technologists |
| Credential | State veterinarian license | Check state law for the applicable credential and supervision requirements |
| May 2025 median annual wage | $130,100 | $47,380 |
| O*NET interest code | IR | RIC |

These are national BLS medians for SOC 29-1131 and 29-2056. The wage for 29-2056 covers both veterinary technologists and technicians. Ask for local figures when comparing job offers and the cost of training. [BLS veterinarians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinarians.htm#tab-5) · [BLS technologists and technicians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.htm#tab-5) · [O*NET veterinarians](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1131.00) · [O*NET veterinary technologists and technicians](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-2056.00)

## Follow one recovery note through the team

A fictional patient is in recovery after a procedure already performed by the care team. Under the clinic's delegation rules, a technician records observations and flags a change for review. The veterinarian reviews the record and decides whether to change the plan. At a shift change, the technician's handoff should make clear what was observed, what is incomplete, and who was notified. The veterinarian's handoff gives the next clinician the reasoning and the decision that still needs attention.

## Check the state rules before choosing a program

Start with the requirements of the state where you plan to work. Veterinarians need a professional degree and a state license. For veterinary technology, ask how a program supports the state credential you want, including examination and education requirements. For example, California's board lists a Veterinary Technician National Examination requirement and several education or experience pathways for Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) applicants. [BLS veterinarian preparation](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinarians.htm#tab-4) · [California RVT application requirements](https://www.vmb.ca.gov/applicants/rvt_forms.shtml)

California's routine delegation rules illustrate the distinction. The supervising veterinarian makes diagnosis and treatment decisions and examines the animal at a time appropriate for the delegated task before delegating it. An RVT's permitted tasks depend on supervision rules. Diagnosis and prescribing generally remain outside the RVT role. California also requires the prescribing veterinarian's signature on a written prescription for a dangerous drug covered by 16 CCR § 2032.2(a)(1). The technician's recovery note documents observations for the team. Other states have their own rules. [California Veterinary Medical Board, §§ 2035–2036](https://www.vmb.ca.gov/laws_regs/rvttasks.shtml) · [California Veterinary Medicine Practice Act, § 2032.2](https://www.vmb.ca.gov/laws_regs/vmb_act.pdf)

## Ask which pressures you would face on a normal shift

Veterinarians may spend part of the day explaining options and making decisions with incomplete information. Technologists and technicians often have physically demanding duties, including handling animals and equipment and keeping records current. Ask what happens if a patient's status changes near the end of a shift, who can decide that the plan must change, and how much of the schedule is overnight or on call. [BLS veterinarian work environment](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinarians.htm#tab-3) · [BLS veterinary technology work environment](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.htm#tab-3)

## Can veterinary technology lead toward veterinary school?

Clinical experience can give you examples of teamwork, consistent documentation, and careful handoffs. If your next goal is a veterinarian license, check veterinary school prerequisites separately and budget for the professional program and licensing steps. If you want greater responsibility in a technician role, ask which duties the clinic can delegate under state rules and what training it provides. [BLS veterinarians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinarians.htm#tab-4) · [BLS veterinary technologists and technicians](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.htm#tab-4)

## Try a 30-minute paper handoff

Use a fictional file with three facts: a scheduled observation is recorded, another entry conflicts with it, and no decision on the next step is logged. Spend 12 minutes writing the technician's handoff with the observation, uncertainty, and person to alert. Spend 12 minutes listing the supporting records a veterinarian would want before making a decision. Spend the last six marking who needs to review what. Keep the exercise on paper and leave clinical actions to the hypothetical team.

## Frequently asked questions
en.afterFaq: Read the [veterinarian profile](/en/career/jobs/veterinarians) and [veterinary technologist and technician profile](/en/career/jobs/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians). The [Holland career interest test](/en/tests/holland-career-interest-test-riasec) can help you describe which tasks you are curious to try.

faq.question: Can a veterinary technician diagnose or prescribe in California?
faq.answer: Under the routine delegation rules in §§ 2035–2036, diagnosis and treatment decisions belong to the supervising veterinarian, and prescribing is generally outside the RVT's scope.

faq.question: Why does the wage table have one figure for technologists and technicians?
faq.answer: BLS publishes a joint median for SOC 29-2056. Use local offers and the employer's job description to compare a specific technician role with a technologist role.

faq.question: What should I ask during a hospital visit?
faq.answer: Ask which notes a new hire writes, who reviews them, and who makes the decision when an observation changes the care plan.

zh.title: 兽医和兽医技师与技术员有什么区别？看诊疗决定和岗位授权
zh.description: 以临床动物诊疗机构为例，比较谁决定诊疗、谁做支持性工作，以及中国执业兽医师与执业助理兽医师的权限边界。
zh.beforeFaq:
## 先看谁对诊疗决定负责

在动物医院，兽医评估病例、决定诊疗计划，并对自己出具的处方或诊疗文件负责。美国职业分类里的「兽医技师与技术员」常执行被委派的检验、观察记录和照护任务，再把发现交回诊疗团队。选岗时，问清谁下决定、谁能执行哪项任务、变化发生时向谁反馈。本文聚焦临床诊疗机构。基层动物防疫、检疫执法岗位要看各自的职责和任职条件。[农业农村部第 6 号令](https://xmsyj.moa.gov.cn/gzdt/202209/t20220909_6408942.htm) · [美国 BLS：兽医技师与技术员](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.htm)

## 同一团队里，两种工作分别交付什么？

| 比较项 | 兽医 | 兽医技师与技术员 |
|---|---|---|
| 核心交付 | 诊疗判断、计划与相应临床记录 | 按岗位权限完成的观察记录、检验结果或照护交接 |
| 含有判断的环节 | 综合病史、检查和检验数据，决定下一步 | 留意记录是否完整、状态是否变化，并报告临床团队 |
| 美国 O*NET 兴趣短码 | IR，研究型、现实型 | RIC，现实型、研究型、常规型 |
| 看国内招聘先问 | 雇主怎样办理或核验资格证和执业备案？ | 岗位是诊疗辅助还是其他分工？实际任务、监督和资格如何核验？ |

技师与技术员一列的任务是美国分类和团队分工示例。国内实际岗位需要另看其身份与适用规定。[O*NET 兽医](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-1131.00) · [O*NET 兽医技师与技术员](https://www.onetonline.org/link/details/29-2056.00)

## 一起看一份术后交接单

虚构一只动物正在诊疗机构留观，接班记录里有一项观察和休息安排未确认。负责病例的执业兽医师根据检查和记录决定是否调整计划；涉及开处方时，由依法开方的执业兽医师签署。具备相应资格和授权的支持人员可按安排记录观察、标出未完成项，及时报告变化。适合交接的写法是把「已观察到的事实」「谁需要复核」「尚未作出的决定」分开，方便下一班找到责任人。这个场景用于理解岗位配合。

## 中国大陆有哪些可以直接查到的资格和权限？

在中国大陆动物诊疗机构从事动物诊疗活动，取得执业兽医资格证书后仍须按规定向机构所在地备案。准备报考可查全国执业兽医资格考试委员会当年的报考公告和专业目录。国家规定还区分执业兽医师与执业助理兽医师。后者可在规定范围开展动物健康检查、采样等工作，并在执业兽医师指导下辅助开展手术、剖检，权限不包括开处方、填写诊断书或出具有关诊疗证明。[执业兽医和乡村兽医管理办法，第 7、11、12、19、20 条](https://xmsyj.moa.gov.cn/gzdt/202209/t20220909_6408942.htm) · [动物防疫法，第 69、70 条](https://fgs.moa.gov.cn/flfg/202104/t20210425_6366545.htm)

第 20 条要求执业兽医师亲自诊断、治疗后才能开具处方、填写诊断书或出具有关诊疗证明。处方签发应由开方的执业兽医师签名、盖章或使用可靠电子签名。支持岗交班记录用于传达事实和待办事项，供负责病例的兽医判断。 [农业农村部第 734 号公告附件](https://www.moa.gov.cn/nybgb/2024/202401/202401/P020240124558272374948.pdf)

国内招聘写「兽医助理」「兽医技术员」时，先问它指的是有资格要求的执业助理兽医师岗位，还是另有分工的辅助岗位。再逐项核对谁授权、谁复核、哪些工作依法需要资格。美国技师与技术员的分工可帮助你理解任务。现有资料尚不能确认该分类在中国大陆有一一对应的岗位或独立准入资格。核对实际工作时，把岗位权限和雇主核验的资格分别问清。

## 选工作环境，问清谁扛哪类压力

兽医常要在信息还不完整时作决定，向动物主人解释取舍，并负责后续记录。支持岗位要让团队及时拿到可用观察记录，同时按现场规则处理动物、设备和交接。分别问目标机构夜间谁负责复核、工作有多少时间在住院照护、哪些情况要立即汇报。[美国 BLS 兽医工作环境](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinarians.htm#tab-3) · [美国 BLS 兽医技师与技术员工作环境](https://www.bls.gov/ooh/healthcare/veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.htm#tab-3)

## 从临床支持转向兽医，要补哪几步？

可以带上去标识的交接改进成果，例如让医生更快发现需要复核项的记录模板。想转入有诊疗决策权限的岗位，再核目标专业是否符合报考条件，确认考试、资格类型和办理备案的顺序。面试时问清机构的带教安排与实际岗位权限，分别估计学习和能承担独立职责的时间。

## 用 30 分钟做一次纸面交班

在虚构记录上写三条信息：「已完成交接观察」「有一项记录互相矛盾」「尚未决定是否调整计划」。先用 12 分钟写一张支持岗交班卡，标清事实、需核项和接收人。再用 12 分钟列出兽医在决定前还需要查看的材料。最后 6 分钟标注哪些内容要由负责的兽医确认。练习只使用虚构信息和纸笔。

faq.answer: 本文资料无法确认美国这类职业与国内岗位或独立资格一一对应。国内某个岗位是否要求执业助理兽医师资格，按实际职责、用人机构和当地适用规定核对。

faq.question: 在本文讨论的动物诊疗机构常规分工中，谁能开处方？
faq.answer: 按农业农村部第 6 号令第 19 条，执业助理兽医师不能开具处方、填写诊断书或出具动物诊疗有关证明文件。涉及地方依第 35 条作出的乡村诊疗授权，按当地规定另核。

faq.question: 另一个岗位的临床经验对报考有帮助吗？
faq.answer: 经验可以帮助你了解工作，也可能用于讨论带教和就业。报考仍要逐项核对当年公布的条件，确认自己适用哪条路径。
